definitions.explanation: Describes someone who endures hardship or frustration without giving up. Emphasizes inner strength and the ability to keep going over a long period.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い{人|ひと}だ。
{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く{待|ま}っていれば、きっとチャンスが{来|く}る。
examples.english: If you wait patiently, an opportunity will surely come.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く{生徒|せいと}の{質問|しつもん}に{答|こた}え{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: The teacher patiently kept answering the students' questions.

notes:
USAGE:
{忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い combines {忍耐|にんたい} (endurance, patience) with {強|つよ}い (strong). It describes a deeper, more sustained patience than simply {我慢強|がまんづよ}い.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く{待|ま}つ (to wait patiently)
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い{性格|せいかく} (patient personality)
- {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}く{取|と}り{組|く}む (to work on something perseveringly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{我慢強|がまんづよ}い focuses on tolerating discomfort or annoyance, while {忍耐強|にんたいづよ}い emphasizes long-term endurance and persistence toward a goal.
